name: Paston
description: Paston (Armenian for 'spades') is a 3-player Preference-style trick game from Gyumri, Armenia. 32 cards, prikup, bidding (paston = spades). Declarer chooses trump, must take at least 6 tricks or surrender.

overview.description: Paston (Armenian for 'spades') is a 3-player Preference-style trick game from Gyumri, Armenia. 32 cards, prikup, bidding (paston = spades). Declarer chooses trump, must take at least 6 tricks or surrender.

history.origins: Armenian game from Gyumri (Leninakan). Name = spades. Rules from Alexey Lobashev; Aram (Gyumri), Aramais Vartanyan (Rostov-on-Don). Form of Preference with unusual scoring.

setup.deck: 32 cards. Suits: gupa (hearts), dineri (diamonds), glitch (clubs), paston (spades). Rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7.

rules.gameplay: 1. Bidding: holder of Jâ™  (or 7â™  if J in prikup) starts. Pass or bid suit. Paston = spades. Rank: clubs < diamonds < hearts < paston. Paston grkha = unbeatable. 2. Declarer takes prikup, discards 2, names trump. 3. Play 10 tricks. 4. Declarer needs 6+ tricks or may surrender.
keyRules: Trump rank: clubs < diamonds < hearts < paston.
Surrender after seeing prikup (cost not multiplied).

strategy.basic: Sacrifice bid when opponent likely to play expensive suit. Surrender can be worthwhile.
strategy.intermediate: Best spades: hard to reach when spades only possible trump. Need opponent to bid hearts to compete.
strategy.advanced: Bidding conventions. Surrender vs play evaluation.
tips: Surrender costs 12 relative; often better than letting opponent score 30-40.
Best spades requires co-operation to bid into hearts.
